messages:
Alice: quick triage: customer Nyx seeing regressions after LoRA merge on int4 probe. Failures concentrated on invoice cents and short JS snippets. Need a fast repro and mitigation plan.

Ben: I'll assemble `nyx_edge_econ` (400 prompts): cents, commas, OCR noise, code fences with small snippets. Will tag expected canonical outputs.

Cara: Run matrix: float32, int8, bnb4-hybrid, bnb4. Try lora-scale 0.55/0.65, and a light rebias 700 steps where needed. Log token probs for `.`, `,`, `0`, `\```.

Diego: Ops note: last time kernel mismatch across hosts caused subtle rounding diffs. If we see host variance, file INFR-5600. Also recommend `--kv-policy preserve-prefix` for warmstart.

Alice: kicking off: `rwi run --model nyx-finetune-v3 --eval nyx_edge_econ --matrix "quant:float32,int8,bnb4-hybrid,bnb4; lora_scale:0.55,0.65" --workers 8 --pool dedicated-nyx`

eval-bot: queued at 1780012400, run_id=nyx-1780012345-matrix-1. Streaming topline when ready.

eval-bot: quick topline: float32=97/100; int8=95/100; bnb4-hybrid (best scale=0.65)=91/100; bnb4=74/100. Main diffs: loss of ".00" and removal of commas in 1,200 -> 1200. Code fence spacing sometimes collapsed.

Cara: sample diffs:
```
Prompt: "Invoice total: $1,200.00"
float32: "Total: $1,200.00" -> OK
bnb4: "Total: $1200" -> parser fails for locale expect ","

Prompt: "```js
let x = 0.00;
```"
float32: same formatting -> OK
bnb4-hybrid: "```js
let x = 0;
```" -> lost cents in code literal -> affects downstream tests
```

Ben: try graft with lora-scale=0.65 + rebias 700 steps on currency tokens. Also enable `--sync-tokenizer true` for consistency.

Diego: I'll check kernel hashes on nodes and open INFR-5600 if mismatch. Also will ensure dedicated-nyx uses kernel v2.1.

eval-bot: graft+rebias run complete (run_id=nyx-1780012345-2): bnb4-hybrid with lora_scale=0.65 + rebias(700) => pass=93/100. Cents failures reduced from 9 -> 2. Code fence literals improved but not perfect. Recommendation: keep int8 for prod, use graft+rebias+bnb4-hybrid as shadow.

Alice: actionable: Ben add micro-pack to nightly smoke, Cara automate graft+rebias job, Diego follow INFR-5600 kernel parity, fallback policy -> int8 if shadow error >2%. Thanks team :thumbsup:
